title: Docs Lead, Platform
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As Platform Docs Lead at Anthropic, you will be the single-threaded owner of developer documentation for the Claude Platform. You'll own the information architecture, the content, and the overall experience of platform.claude.com/docs — from a developer's first quickstart to the reference page they keep open in a pinned tab. This role sits on the DevX team and is closer to DevRel than to traditional technical writing. The job is taste, judgment, and end-to-end developer empathy in addition to strong writing skills: you'll be expected to build with the Claude API yourself, understand the product firsthand, and turn that understanding into documentation developers genuinely love. You'll also own documentation written for AI agents and contribute to the skill that teaches Claude how to help developers use the Claude API. Writing for an LLM reader is a new craft, and you'll be one of the people defining what good looks like. Key responsibilities Set and hold the quality bar for every page on platform.claude.com/docs — clarity, correctness, completeness, voice Own the information architecture: structure the docs so developers and agents find what they need on the first try, and restructure when the product evolves underneath it Write and rewrite the highest-leverage pages yourself; review and edit contributions from product, engineering, and DevRel partners Own docs for new launches end-to-end, from early PRD through GA Write docs for agents as well as humans Ship code on the Claude API regularly so your understanding of the developer experience is firsthand, not secondhand Contribute to the claude-api skill, and author and maintain related docs-for-agents artifacts, defining how documentation should be written for LLM consumers Act as the primary customer of our internal docs-automation tooling, with a calibrated point of view on where Claude accelerates docs work and where human judgment is the bottleneck Build feedback loops from support tickets, community channels, and product analytics into docs improvements, and measure whether those improvements actually reduce confusion Partner closely with the DevX engineers who own the docs platform to shape the reading experience, navigation, search, and in-product docs surfaces Translate recurring developer friction into concrete product and API feedback when documentation alone can't fix it Minimum qualifications You've been the end-to-end owner (not just a contributor) of a developer-facing surface like docs, SDKs, quickstarts, or a content program: setting a quality bar, holding it without being chased, and saying no to things that don't meet it You're an excellent technical writer. You can take a confusing page and make it clear, take a correct page and make it useful, and explain why each change made it better You have strong information architecture skills and can articulate why a docs site is structured well or badly within minutes of landing on it You're hands-on technical. You write and read code in at least one programming language, you've shipped working software on top of APIs, and you can hold your own in a design discussion with engineers Preferred qualifications Background in developer relations, developer experience, developer education, or API product teams Experience owning docs or developer content at an API-first or developer-tools company Genuine curiosity about building with LLMs and a calibrated, non-hype view of what they're good at today Experience writing content intended for LLM consumption (skills, system prompts, retrieval corpora) Background in information architecture, UX writing, or content design Experience working with docs-as-code toolchains and contributing to docs infrastructure Public writing that demonstrates your voice (blog, newsletter, talks, open-source docs) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $365,000 — $435,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.
